name: search_prepare1

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd();print((p/'search-budget.json').read_text());print('LEDGER', (p/'search-charges.jsonl').read_text() if (p/'search-charges.jsonl').exists() else 'absent');print('GET_LEDGER',(p/'guard-ledger.jsonl').read_text() if (p/'guard-ledger.jsonl').exists() else 'absent')
plan={'queries':['"1206.5179" "Canonical forms"','"Rank of 3-tensors with 2 slices and Kronecker canonical forms"','"Optimal evaluation of pairs of bilinear forms" JaJa']}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'search-plan1.json'],input=json.dumps(plan),text=True,capture_output=True);print(r.stdout);assert r.returncode==0
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'charge_search.py'),'search-plan1.json'],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.stdout,r.stderr);assert r.returncode==0
